arguments.text: 8 km, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Calibration: boat CP 107 W / 11.4 kJ, pod CP 162 W / 19.2 kJ (may be 10-25 pct off). Target: settle after the start to about pod 165-170 W (boat ~110 W), even effort, keep pod reserve above ~30 pct until 2 km to go, then spend it: push at 1500 m to go, finish sprint at ~400 m to go. Watch for incidents: sudden drop in push_local (weed on rudder / drag) -> consider clear_rudder; pod vs boat power diverging (pod drift); radio course change -> set_race_distance and tell. Compare same-direction legs for current.

8 km, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back (turns at each 1000 m; odd legs north, even legs south). Calibration: boat CP 107 W / 11.4 kJ, pod CP 162 W / 19.2 kJ (may be 10-25 pct off). Paddler drifts to ~175-178 W pod if left alone (overspends); ease without a pace target does nothing, ease WITH an over-ground pace target works. Method: just after each turn cue ease/hold with a leg pace target for ~166 W pod: north legs ~160 s/500, south legs ~167 s/500 (re-check push_along). Keep pod reserve above ~25 pct until 2 km to go, then push at 1500 m to go, finish sprint at ~400 m to go. Incidents: drag_jump watch (weed -> clear_rudder if speed per pod watt drops in both directions), pod vs boat power diverging (pod drift), radio course change -> set_race_distance and tell.
